chapter_theme: The three supremes: Siva as the Supreme, the supreme beyond the supreme, and the Supreme in oneself (tatpara), reached beyond the thirty-six tattvas and the states of the soul. He comes to the soul like a mother to her calf, and is reached by a clinging that ends clinging, in a bliss that knowledge makes.
structure_note: The verses name the supremes in turn: சிவபரம் (2447), பரம்பரம் (2448, 2449) and தற்பரம் (2450, 2451); 2445 and 2446 describe the Lord rising within and filling the hall.

2445.reading: Having reached the First One of the three-tiered circle, who appeared within me and rises whirling, and dwelling there in joy, the young creeper hangs down and does good: this is how good is given.
2445.nuance: மூன்று படி மண்டலம் is traditionally the three circles of fire, sun and moon in the yogic body. இளங்கொடி (the young creeper) is taken as Shakti, perhaps kundalini. The verse is built on images that can't be fixed from it.

2446.reading: What filled the hall became the great Supreme, and Nandi stood filling it and came face to face; once he came like a mother rising at the thought of her calf, he became a lamp of virtue filling the hill.
2446.nuance: மன்று is the hall of the dance. The cow who rises at the very thought of her calf (கன்று நினைந்தெழு தாய்) makes grace come unbidden. குன்று நிறைந்த விளக்கு, a lamp filling the hill, echoes 2407.

2447.reading: Beyond the thirty-six tattvas and beyond that is the teaching that cannot be told, and if told, it is Siva the Supreme; the Lord of the Veda appeared as distinct, so that bliss and attainment grow.
2447.nuance: கூறா உபதேசம் கூறில் (if the untellable teaching is told) is the familiar paradox. வேதப் பசுவனார் is obscure: perhaps the Lord of souls (Pasupati) of the Veda, or the Veda as a cow.

2448.reading: If one clings so that clinging ends, that is the supreme Lord; the knowledge of the Supreme is the Supreme; and for those who can cling in that clinging so that clinging ends, it is the supreme beyond the supreme.
2448.nuance: பற்றறப் பற்றில் opens every line: 'if one clings so that clinging ends', or 'in the clinging free of clinging'. பரம்பரம் is the supreme above the supreme, the second of the chapter's three.

2449.reading: The supreme beyond the supreme, which Lord and bond do not hold, becomes Parasiva to be reached; and the bliss of Parasiva, the supreme beyond the supreme, is made as such by knowledge.
2449.nuance: பதிபாசம் பற்றா, which pati and pasam do not hold, sets the highest beyond even the category of Lord. The last line makes knowledge the maker of the bliss; that may mean realisation is the knowing itself.

2450.reading: In waking, leaving the five beginning with kala, becoming itself in the lone kevala state, going beyond thought into the state beyond, and reaching what is known there, the soul itself is the Supreme within.
2450.nuance: கலாதி நாலொன்று (kala and the rest, four and one) is taken as the five sheaths that limit the soul (kala, vidya, raga, niyati, kala). நேயம் may be the object of knowing (jneya) or love. தற்பரம் is the third supreme, the Supreme as one's own.

2451.reading: The purity one sees in oneself, the vastness in oneself, the fault seen afterwards, all falter, and tatpara and the supreme of time mingle and end; that good state beyond the Supreme is to be sought through the letters beginning with A.
2451.nuance: தூடணம் is dushana (fault), and கால பரம் perhaps the supreme as time. அகராதி, the letters beginning with A, may mean the parts of Om or the mantra letters. The verse is compressed and its steps are not clear.

links.note: Both turn on பற்று: the Kural bids one cling to the one without clinging in order to let go of clinging; Tirumular repeats 'clinging so that clinging ends' in every line and makes it the way to the supreme beyond the supreme.

Both use the cow and her calf. In the Naladiyar the calf finds its mother among many cows as an old deed finds its doer; in Tirumular the mother rises at the thought of her calf, as the Lord comes to the soul. One image carries karma, the other grace.
Both end on a lamp on a hill: in 2407 worship makes the knowledge like a lamp on the western hill, in 2446 Nandi becomes a lamp of virtue filling the hill.
Both have the freed soul passing through kevala to the state beyond while still in waking (நனவில் அதீதம்).

source_issues: 2451: lines 1 to 3 (தற்கண்ட தூயமும், பிற்காணும் தூடணம், கால பரமும்) are obscure and may be corrupt.
